en.label: [section] Aim of the course and learning outcomes:
en.content: The graduates will gain a general overview of the theory and practice of regional and cohesion policy. They will be able to critically assess submitted programs, projects and strategies of regional and cohesion policy. Emphasis is also placed on territorial dimension.
